retrievalProfile.description: A centered, illuminated arched stained glass window featuring playing card motifs set against a void-like black background with soft light rays.
excludeWhen: the request is for a realistic church interior
the style is modern flat vector
the background is bright or detailed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition dominated by a central arched stained glass window. The window depicts a stylized King of Diamonds in traditional playing card symmetry, integrated into leaded glass panes. The window glows from within, casting subtle light rays onto a dark, textured floor, while the surrounding environment is a total black void.
coreVisualRelationships: Central arched window against a vast black negative space
Internal symmetry of the playing card figure within the architectural frame
Warm internal illumination contrasting with the cold dark exterior
Text integrated into the upper glass panes following the arch's curve
coreInvariants: Leaded glass texture with black outlines
Playing card suit and rank iconography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The window is centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face of the King in the center of the glass window.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, follow the arch down through the glass figure, and settle on the light rays at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black negative space surrounding the window to create a sense of isolation and mystery.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, blue, and purple (stained glass segments)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the zero-value background and the high-saturation, high-value illuminated glass.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are contained within specific glass panes
Variable stroke widths with calligraphic flourishes
Integrated into the leaded structure of the window
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated serifs and swashes
Lowercase letters have a rounded, uncial-inspired structure
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, modern sans-serif or serif for external metadata to contrast the medieval glass lettering.
graphicDevices: Card suit symbols (diamonds, hearts, clubs, spades)

preserve: The integration into the glass panes
avoid: Placing text outside the window frame

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the medieval, ecclesiastical feel of the window
Provides the rounded, historical look seen in the lowercase characters

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central arched stained glass window featuring a King of Diamonds playing card design. The window should be glowing from within, set against a pitch-black background with soft light rays hitting a dark floor below.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add calligraphic text into the top three panes of the window arch, ensuring the letters look like they are painted onto or part of the glass texture.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it belongs in the glass panes?
Is the playing card symmetry maintained?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the leaded glass patterns
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
Exact facial features of the king

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between light and dark

postGenerationChecks: Verify the arch is perfectly symmetrical
Ensure the light rays don't wash out the glass details
Confirm the text is legible but stylized
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject] in [Arched Stained Glass] style + [Black Void Background] + [Internal Illumination] + [Integrated Medieval Typography]
